label: [P-sketch] Estimate U for cross/sub-line
statement: Estimate U_cross: There exist C0<∞ and r_ε<1 such that every polymer γ appearing in the N11 expansion of a cross-line (or axis sub-line) point at level h_p — i.e. a defect configuration whose bump set meets the seam of the (η₊):(η₋) splitting with min(d₊,d₋) divisor data — satisfies |z_γ| ≤ C0 * r_ε^{n_nr(γ)}, where n_nr counts non-resonant λ-sites (twist |τ-b|≥η, η=1/20).
transfer_question: Do the same (C0,r) certified on background-0/½ typed bumps also dominate cross-line seam polymers? Numerically: compare empirical |X_cross|/|X_binet| decay vs C0 * r^{seam}.
geometries: cross line: 0≠c | h_p, both ± embeddings large
axis sub-line: 0≠c in ā_{-σ} (Lemma S); G≥√min only
